defmodule SearchIndexer.Auth do
  @moduledoc "Cross-service authentication for search indexing pipeline"

  @hmac_secret Application.compile_env(:search_indexer, :hmac_secret, "default_secret_key_32bytes_long!!")

  def generate_auth_header(service_name, timestamp) do
    payload = "#{service_name}|#{timestamp}"
    signature = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_secret, payload) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    "X-Service-Auth: #{service_name}|#{timestamp}|#{signature}"
  end

  def verify_auth_header(header_value) do
    case String.split(header_value, "|", parts: 3) do
      [service_name, timestamp, signature] ->
        expected_payload = "#{service_name}|#{timestamp}"
        expected_sig = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_secret, expected_payload) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
        if secure_compare(signature, expected_sig) do
          {:ok, service_name}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_signature}
        end
      _ ->
        {:error, :malformed_header}
    end
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
    :crypto.hash_equals(a, b)
  end
  defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false
end

defmodule SearchIndexer.HttpClient do
  @moduledoc "HTTP client for communicating with the search backend"

  def build_request(method, path, headers, body) do
    header_block = Enum.map(headers, fn {k, v} -> "#{k}: #{v}" end) |> Enum.join("\r\n")
    request_line = "#{method} #{path} HTTP/1.1"
    "#{request_line}\r\n#{header_block}\r\n\r\n#{body}"
  end

  def send_request(host, port, raw_request) do
    case :gen_tcp.connect(String.to_charlist(host), port, [:binary, active: false]) do
      {:ok, socket} ->
        :gen_tcp.send(socket, raw_request)
        result = recv_response(socket, <<>>)
        :gen_tcp.close(socket)
        result
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp recv_response(socket, acc) do
    case :gen_tcp.recv(socket, 0, 5000) do
      {:ok, data} -> recv_response(socket, acc <> data)
      {:error, :closed} -> {:ok, acc}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end
end

defmodule SearchIndexer.IndexService do
  @moduledoc "Service for indexing documents into the search backend"

  @search_backend_host "search-backend.internal"
  @search_backend_port 9200

  def index_document(collection, doc_id, document, metadata \\ %{}) do
    timestamp = System.system_time(:second) |> Integer.to_string()
    auth_header = SearchIndexer.Auth.generate_auth_header("indexer", timestamp)

    path = build_index_path(collection, doc_id)
    body = Jason.encode!(%{document: document, metadata: metadata})

    custom_headers = build_metadata_headers(metadata)

    headers = [
      {"Host", @search_backend_host},
      {"Content-Type", "application/json"},
      {"Content-Length", Integer.to_string(byte_size(body))},
      {"X-Index-Collection", collection}
    ] ++ custom_headers ++ parse_auth_header(auth_header)

    raw_request = SearchIndexer.HttpClient.build_request("PUT", path, headers, body)
    SearchIndexer.HttpClient.send_request(@search_backend_host, @search_backend_port, raw_request)
  end

  defp build_index_path(collection, doc_id) do
    safe_collection = URI.encode_www_form(collection)
    safe_doc_id = URI.encode_www_form(doc_id)
    "/indices/#{safe_collection}/docs/#{safe_doc_id}"
  end

  defp build_metadata_headers(metadata) do
    metadata
    |> Enum.filter(fn {k, _v} -> String.starts_with?(to_string(k), "x_custom_") end)
    |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} ->
      header_name = k |> to_string() |> String.replace("x_custom_", "X-Custom-") |> headerize_key()
      {header_name, sanitize_header_value(v)}
    end)
  end

  defp headerize_key(key) do
    key
    |> String.split("_")
    |> Enum.map(&String.capitalize/1)
    |> Enum.join("-")
  end

  defp sanitize_header_value(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value
    |> String.replace(~r/[\r\n]/, "")
  end
  defp sanitize_header_value(value), do: to_string(value)

  defp parse_auth_header(auth_header_line) do
    case String.split(auth_header_line, ": ", parts: 2) do
      [name, value] -> [{name, value}]
      _ -> []
    end
  end

  def bulk_index(collection, documents) when is_list(documents) do
    Enum.map(documents, fn {doc_id, doc, meta} ->
      index_document(collection, doc_id, doc, meta)
    end)
  end

  def search_and_reindex(query_params, target_collection) do
    source_path = "/search?" <> URI.encode_query(query_params)
    timestamp = System.system_time(:second) |> Integer.to_string()
    auth_header = SearchIndexer.Auth.generate_auth_header("indexer", timestamp)

    headers = [
      {"Host", @search_backend_host},
      {"Accept", "application/json"}
    ] ++ parse_auth_header(auth_header)

    raw_request = SearchIndexer.HttpClient.build_request("GET", source_path, headers, "")

    case SearchIndexer.HttpClient.send_request(@search_backend_host, @search_backend_port, raw_request) do
      {:ok, response} -> process_search_results(response, target_collection)
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp process_search_results(response, target_collection) do
    case extract_body(response) do
      {:ok, body} ->
        case Jason.decode(body) do
          {:ok, %{"hits" => hits}} ->
            results = Enum.map(hits, fn hit ->
              index_document(target_collection, hit["id"], hit["source"], hit["meta"] || %{})
            end)
            {:ok, results}
          _ -> {:error, :parse_error}
        end
      error -> error
    end
  end

  defp extract_body(response) do
    case String.split(response, "\r\n\r\n", parts: 2) do
      [_headers, body] -> {:ok, body}
      _ -> {:error, :no_body}
    end
  end
end

defmodule SearchIndexer.WebhookHandler do
  @moduledoc "Handles incoming webhook notifications to trigger reindexing"

  def handle_webhook(conn_params) do
    with {:ok, service} <- authenticate_request(conn_params),
         {:ok, payload} <- validate_payload(conn_params.body) do
      collection = payload["collection"] || "default"
      doc_id = payload["doc_id"]
      document = payload["document"]
      tags = payload["tags"] || ""

      metadata = %{
        "x_custom_source" => service,
        "x_custom_tags" => tags,
        "x_custom_trace_id" => conn_params.headers["x-trace-id"] || generate_trace_id()
      }

      SearchIndexer.IndexService.index_document(collection, doc_id, document, metadata)
    end
  end

  defp authenticate_request(conn_params) do
    case Map.get(conn_params.headers, "x-service-auth") do
      nil -> {:error, :missing_auth}
      value -> SearchIndexer.Auth.verify_auth_header(value)
    end
  end

  defp validate_payload(body) when is_map(body) do
    if Map.has_key?(body, "doc_id") and Map.has_key?(body, "document") do
      {:ok, body}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_payload}
    end
  end
  defp validate_payload(_), do: {:error, :invalid_payload}

  defp generate_trace_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end
end
